scoring_justification: Raw DFT band structure data (k-points, eigenvalues) is not required by the output contract; only final verdicts are produced. Recomputing the band gap from raw outputs is therefore infeasible. Result-level comparison against paper-reported values with tolerances is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold verdict for Mg3Bi2 (metallic) and band gap for Mg3Sb2 (0.12 eV)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text, Section 8 (abstract and band structure discussion): Mg3Bi2 is metallic, Mg3Sb2 has indirect gap of about 0.12 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the values reported in the paper; they are not invented.

schema.description: Single line of text. If no band gap exists, write the word 'metallic' (case-insensitive). If a band gap exists, write its value in eV as a floating-point number.

outputs.description: Verdict on the band gap of Mg3Bi2 after a DFT calculation including spin-orbit coupling.

schema.description: Single line containing a floating-point number representing the indirect band gap of Mg3Sb2 in eV.

outputs.description: Computed indirect band gap of Mg3Sb2 from a scalar-relativistic DFT band structure calculation.

output_contract.notes: Both artifacts are scored by comparing to hidden paper-reported values. The checker for step_01 expects a case-insensitive match to 'metallic' (or a numeric gap if the calculation yields one). The checker for step_02 compares the submitted gap to a hidden reference with a tolerance.

steps.description: Band gap in eV with tolerance ±0.1 eV; partial credit outside tolerance
